propositions: Server-side web-search capability required by criterion T1 was silently removed when production review bot cut over to Bedrock, because the condition resolved.startswith('anthropic') returned False for 'bedrock:us.anthropic.claude-opus-4-8'.
The attachment decision incorrectly used provider-name prefix matching instead of capability registry membership, violating the epic's zero-exceptions rule against prefix-based qualification.
T1 now executes on weaker evidence (codebase and model knowledge alone) for blocking decisions on bright-line plans, with no observable signal in the verdict that grounding was withheld.
Bedrock's Converse API does not expose Anthropic's native server-side web_search tool, so T1 must be served via a local search fallback (DuckDuckGo) to maintain web access across all providers.

The fix moves the web-access decision from anthropic_model.py to capabilities.py, deriving it from model profile supported_native_tools registry membership rather than provider-name shape, and records the outcome (native/local/off) in provider_provenance.capabilities.web_access.
